data_properties.definition: A datatype relation that associates a train with a train-number identifier.
data_properties.label: has train number
data_properties.rationale: Rail vehicle identifier analogous in purpose to, but not a duplicate of, tail number, MSN, or ICAO code.

data_properties.definition: A datatype relation that associates a rail journey plan with its scheduled departure time.
data_properties.label: has scheduled departure time
data_properties.rationale: Places schedule data on the plan information entity rather than on the journey process, and does not duplicate boarding time or reservation number.
